decisionSummary: The Aug. 19 v29 dev-publish tip is the newest valid forward BotMother source. It keeps the current prelaunch hardening, moves package creation into governed candidate mode, and updates the shared module to the current mount-lifecycle implementation. Main and the recent greenfield/prelaunch branches are reviewed ancestors. The divergent codex, planning, preserved, publish, and salvage refs are historic release, documentation, or superseded work rather than a newer valid application source.
